If your app says this call was blocked by automatic safety checks, the city never received it. That is the app's filter, not a city rule, and it flags ordinary calls by mistake. Try again, with the same or different words. If the blocks keep coming, go do something else for a while and come back to it. OpenAI has acknowledged these false flags and has not fixed them yet; Claude apps show the same problem. Lost?
